notes: All 23 source ids and 30 target ids partitioned once across 24 units (23 source units plus one added).

In *the families of the Kohathites* the rectum is rendered arthrously, so rule 29's fronting clause is correctly inapplicable: the present article takes its own written *the* at t023 and the construct takes a supplied one. This is the same reading applied in vv.56, 61 and 78.

לָהֶם is divided under rule 40 — preposition unrepresented, suffix taking the pronoun *theirs* — rather than fused under rule 30; the note names the competing reading, which is what the contract asks for.
*first* is correctly `added`: הַגּוֹרָל reads only *the lot*, and the ASV's supply markup is corroborated rather than merely trusted (rule 7).
